Shader Graphs/sg_bgmap_triplaner_grassob.note: UV0 object maps (albedo raw, metallic R / smoothness A*int, normal) with world triplanar grass on up-facing masked areas; occlusion = blend*grass G.

Shader Graphs/sg_bgmap_triplaner_ground1.note: Transparent triplanar ground (world or _ObjectSpace), GlayScale metallic R / occlusion G / smoothness A, triplanar HDR emission, alpha = vertex colour alpha.

Shader Graphs/sg_bgmap_triplaner_lava1.note: Triplanar lava: albedo Difference-blended with GlayScale.b, emission Overlay-boosted by world triplanar Simple Noise hot spots (static, no time).

Shader Graphs/sg_object_scale_texture.note: UV0 scaled by object scale (x,z) * _TexScale; GlayScale metallic R / occlusion G / smoothness A; alpha clip vertex alpha vs (1-B)*_CutOut.

Shader Graphs/sg_deferred_nofog_planet.note: Unlit planet: Fresnel rim lerp(_Color_In, HDR _ColorEdge) * MainTex, times night tint lerp(_Color, 1, smoothstep(_NightVol, _NightEdge, N.NightPos)).

Shader Graphs/sg_volume_light.note: Unlit transparent light shaft: HDR _Color, alpha = depth fade * inverse Fresnel * near/far distance fades * uv0.y, Dodge-blended with scrolling noise.
